texts: When a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern produces mist-light.
Whenever a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern gives mist-light.
Mist-light is a pale silver flame.
Ordinary oil does not produce mist-light.

fields.sentence: When a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern produces mist-light.
parse: (: lantern_burn_produce (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Member $e1 burn) (Agent $e1 $x) (Patient $e1 mire_essence)) (And (Member (sk_produce $x $e1) produce) (Agent (sk_produce $x $e1) $x) (Patient (sk_produce $x $e1) mist_light) (During (sk_produce $x $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare "when P, Q" with an indefinite participant is routed through the whenever machinery as specified (premise clause, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9), the anaphoric "the lantern" binds to the premise variable, and burn/produce both take Patient by the change test. Compound genus atoms for mire_essence and mist_light are emitted with no noun-modifier genus, per Compound concepts.

fields.sentence: Whenever a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern gives mist-light.
parse: (: lantern_burn_gives_light (Implication (And (Member $L lantern) (Member $e burn) (Agent $e $L) (Patient $e mire_essence)) (And (Member (sk_give $e) give) (Agent (sk_give $e) $L) (Theme (sk_give $e) mist_light) (During (sk_give $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever routes to the occurrence rule with a per-occurrence Skolem consequent and the During tie, no QuantifierPhrase companion, and STV 1.0 0.9 — all as specified; the anaphoric 'the lantern' correctly reuses the premise variable. Compound genus atoms for mire_essence/mist_light are emitted with their noun modifiers correctly left unexposed, and burn/give take Patient/Theme per the object-change test.

fields.sentence: Mist-light is a pale silver flame.

q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance mist_light pale) takes the definitional dial (STV 1.0 0.99), but a contingent kind-level appearance claim is the empirical case per 'all swans are white' / 'Trellises are wooden' (STV 0.9 0.9) and the 'when unsure -> empirical' default.
(Inheritance mist_light silver) carries the same definitional 1.0/0.99 where the empirical-generic 0.9/0.9 is indicated.

review.notes: Compound handling is correct: genus (Inheritance mist_light light) with the noun modifier 'mist' unexposed, and the colour adjectives split out rather than fused (incidental description bars fusion). The kind-identity atom (Inheritance mist_light flame) at 1.0/0.99 reads definitional and is fine.

issues.reason: A bare generic's contingent property takes the empirical dial ('Trellises are wooden' / 'Apples are sweet' -> (STV 0.9 0.9); colour is the instruction set's own empirical exemplar in 'all swans are white', and 'when unsure -> empirical'), so (Inheritance mist_light pale) at 1.0/0.99 over-asserts a definitional, exceptionless claim the text does not make.

Same dial: (Inheritance mist_light silver) is a kind-level appearance claim, empirical by the 'could a counterexample exist' test and the unsure-default, so it takes (STV 0.9 0.9), not the taxonomic 1.0/0.99 reserved for the flame kind atom.

new_gaps: Adjective-stacked colour ('a pale silver flame'): the instruction set does not say whether 'pale' modifies the colour term (one shade property) or the head independently (two properties); the parse's two-atom split is an improvisation.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: (Inheritance mist_light pale) at (STV 0.9 0.9). Issue 1: (Inheritance mist_light silver) at (STV 0.9 0.9); the genus (Inheritance mist_light light) and kind atom (Inheritance mist_light flame) keep 1.0/0.99.
adjudication.notes: Compound handling (noun modifier 'mist' unexposed, genus 'light', colour adjectives unfused) is correct; the only fault is the truth-value dial on the two appearance atoms.

fields.sentence: Ordinary oil does not produce mist-light.

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route rather than a kind relation, with 'ordinary' as a premise conjunct; strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9 matches the negated-verbal-generic dial, plain 'not' correctly takes no QuantifierPhrase, and mist_light gets its head genus with the noun modifier left unexposed.
